guide.title: Graduation Days 2026

photography: Professional photography of graduands crossing the stage will be available with gown drop-off in the City and Guilds Building.
Professional portrait photography is also available in the Queen’s Tower Rooms, Sherfield Building, from 07.00–22.00 on Graduation Days 2026.
politeRequests: Turn off phones or keep on silent mode.
Minimise ceremony photography (no selfies on stage and no flash photography).
Graduands: return to your seat after graduating and remain seated.

welcomeText: We are delighted to welcome you to Imperial’s Graduation Days 2026, here at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall. This is a special moment in our academic year – a time to celebrate achievement, perseverance and the remarkable community that surrounds our graduates.

Your graduation ceremony represents years of curiosity, discovery and resilience – and this is just the beginning. You now join Imperial’s global alumni community – an extraordinary network of leaders, entrepreneurs, researchers and changemakers across the world.

As you take your next steps, stay connected to one another and to Imperial. Be ambitious in your aims, generous in your leadership, and fearless in applying your scientific imagination to the challenges ahead.
We are immensely proud of everything you have achieved, and we look forward with excitement to the impact you will make.

dean.body: Your engineering education at Imperial has given you the analytical rigour, creativity and technical depth to tackle the defining challenges of our time. This is your moment to reflect on all that you've achieved, and to look ahead with confidence to everything still to come.
dean.name: Professor Faron Moller
dean.intro: Congratulations to all those graduating from the Faculty of Engineering today.
